poc_details: POC: Dedicated cluster (single AZ) -> canary route 10% traffic to new cluster; validate canary for 7 days then 50% -> full. Fallback: route to hosted API model variant if Dedicated latency breaches 300ms p95 or error rate >1%. Rollback: automated rollback policy based on eval set BLEU/ROUGE drop >5% or human-quality regression flagged. Migrate plan includes KV cache prewarm, prefix caching for frequent queries.
latency_targets: chat p95 <= 250ms (NA), embeddings <= 50ms; allowed spike window 10s for autoscale
throughput_targets: steady 400 rps for chat, bursts to 2k rps for search/embeds
cost_sensitivity: medium — will flip to Dedicated if per-token cost decreases by ~30% at target throughput

- Canary deploys per model variant

- Automatic fallback to smaller quantized model on overload
